title: Douglas Hofstadter — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Douglas Hofstadter's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. pieces.title: A strange loop
pieces.caption: The picture at the top of his page, hung inside itself seven times. Follow it inward and you never reach a picture that is not this picture. *What is real and what is a choice:* A picture of self-reference, which is his phrase's first half. It says nothing about a self.

verdicts.file: Douglas Hofstadter — rich — a strange loop.png
verdicts.why: The one piece in the batch that is a little out of the ordinary and needs no key: his own hero, the man asleep on the book, falling into itself. It matches the page's third example, a feedback patch that turns its output back into its input. Notes for the words, not the picture. The title calls it a strange loop; a picture inside itself goes down and never comes back to the top, and the "paradoxical level-crossing" in the quoted line is the part it lacks.
